title: Astronaut crew quarters: something came back with them

tellings.quote: never be the same. He said that every time that thing went up, when it came back down, something came with them and it was still there.

plain: At the astronauts' crew quarters at Cape Canaveral, the Florida launch site, something is said to have come back with the crews after every flight and stayed. Chris Bledsoe, a man known for his own UFO encounters, passes this on from a man named Timothy Taylor, who said that "every time that thing went up, when it came back down, something came with them and it was still there." If true, spaceflight would have brought back some kind of presence that still lingers in the building.
